picks.title: Synthetic-user startup Simile raises $200M at $2B valuation 5 months after $100M Series A
picks.why_it_matters: The explosive valuation growth signals synthetic data/testing infrastructure is becoming a must-have category, creating potential opportunities for adjacent early-stage plays in AI development tooling.

picks.title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso — source says for about $200M
picks.why_it_matters: This exit validates non-human identity security as an acquirable category, suggesting strong M&A appetite for startups securing AI agents and machine-to-machine authentication.

picks.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
picks.why_it_matters: Google's advancement in embodied AI signals accelerating platform shifts that could unlock new startup opportunities in robotics applications, simulation environments, and hardware integration layers.
